name: rea
description: Reverse engineer native, managed, Electron/JavaScript, packaged, firmware, and browser targets with REA. Runtime support boundaries are documented in PACKAGE_SUPPORT.md.
skillInstructions: Kimi exposes REA tools as mcp__plugin-rea_rea__<tool>. This server uses REA_MCP_TOOL_CATALOG_PROFILE=full. Call select_tools with a capability query, then call it again with exact qualified tool names to load their schemas; do not look for mcp__plugin-rea_rea__discover_tools. Do not run rea setup: this managed plugin already owns registration, and setup would create a second mcp.json registration.
